stopReason: The repaired branch passed a direct non-AppContainer production-runner discriminant, a production-used native wait deadline sentinel, native-helper production bundling, architecture contract, typecheck, changed-only imports, custody, and diff hygiene. The single authorized post-repair real AppContainer seam nevertheless emitted the same exact {mode: execute, reason: timed-out} after 85.219 seconds. Hard self-termination did not shift the failure, so no second seam was started and the newest callback-failure workspace was retained.

changes: Extract the production-used 20 ms native process wait driver behind a deterministic clock/wait seam.
Freeze child deadline timeout into the existing receipt-backed failure protocol before the host watchdog.
Prefer TerminateProcess on the current helper process after synchronous finite protocol writes, with ExitProcess as fallback.
Refresh the protected custody ledger for all changed protected files.

directNonAppContainerProductionRunner.proves: The same materialized production runner and both controlled-failure paths settle without AppContainer.

argv: ^isolated runtime capability builds a host-path-free production runner bundle and crosses the real AppContainer boundary$

proven: The production runner bundle and its controlled failure paths are not the timeout source outside AppContainer.
The production native wait driver converts its child deadline into a finite timeout failure under deterministic time.
The post-repair host command still reaches its outer execute timeout.
No retained scene proves entry into the first bootstrap checkpoint.
notProven: Whether the helper process itself remained open at the host deadline.
Whether the helper exited while an AppContainer descendant or Job remained open.
Which synchronous FFI boundary last returned before the timeout.

nextTaskEnvelope.goal: Without expanding the public error or the existing {mode, reason} settlement sidecar, use a temporary test-only finite projection of childCloseObserved, streamsDrained, and treeClosed to distinguish a helper-process hang from a surviving AppContainer descendant before choosing the next canonical repair.
forbidden: running another real AppContainer seam in the same batch
deleting or mutating any retained workspace
persisting raw outcome, output, paths, argv, environment, messages, causes, stacks, SIDs, or profile names
weakening AppContainer, ACL, timeout, host-path, relocation, lease, or public diagnostic contracts
running full, slow, public vertical, or GitHub Actions lanes
